purpose: Prevent recurrence of the Sumatra E3 exact-state custody failure.
before_arm_workspace_retirement: create a deterministic source bundle or patch bundle for each arm against the exact common base
record the exact arm commit/tree identity
store the bundle in EvoNOMOS durable GitHub history or another canonical durable artifact location reachable without the local workspace
store build/test/oracle receipt separately from treatment bytes
verify a fresh readback can reconstruct the exact arm without using prose or model memory
hard_stop: No lifecycle measurement phase may be authorized if either exact arm cannot be reconstructed from durable custody artifacts.
